name: Ranked possession
summary: Shared possession controller: answer verdicts, passes, kick contact and phase whistles already have cues. Goals, saves, selection and end results need dedicated feedback.

actions.label: Match found
actions.when: Once when the match becomes ready; do not repeat during reconnect.

actions.label: Ban category
actions.when: When the category ban is accepted, once per draft action.

actions.label: Start round
actions.when: When the countdown hands over to active play, after audio is unlocked.

actions.label: Select an answer
actions.when: On a committed selection; never on hover or every keystroke.

actions.label: Lock in
actions.when: Once a valid submission is accepted; disable while pending.

actions.label: Correct answer
actions.when: On the confirmed result, once per question or command ID.

actions.label: Wrong answer
actions.when: On confirmed incorrect result. Never also play the timeout cue.

actions.label: Last 3 seconds
actions.when: One tick at each whole second: 3, 2, 1. Stop on answer, pause or end.

actions.label: Time runs out
actions.when: Once when the active turn expires. Replaces wrong-answer feedback for no answer.

actions.label: Pass completed
actions.when: At the ball transfer or chain link animation; throttle rapid repeats.

actions.label: Take the shot
actions.when: At visible ball contact, not immediately on the shoot button.

actions.label: Goal scored
actions.when: At goal impact / score reveal, after the kick.

actions.label: Keeper saves
actions.when: At glove contact or confirmed miss; no victory sting.

actions.label: Half / phase ends
actions.when: On halftime, shootout transition or final whistle; once per phase.

actions.label: Streak milestone
actions.when: At a meaningful confirmed milestone; replace or follow the regular correct cue.

actions.label: Next question
actions.when: At the visible question transition, not on data prefetch.

actions.label: Win / complete
actions.when: When the final outcome is visible. Wait for the answer sound to finish.

actions.label: Lose / eliminated
actions.when: On the terminal loss, once. Do not layer on top of the wrong answer.

actions.label: Draw
actions.when: When the authoritative result is a draw.

actions.label: Collect reward
actions.when: When a reward is confirmed and visibly added; one cue per award.

actions.label: Play resumes
actions.when: Once when the paused match actually resumes.
